source.stem: Which statement about bonding is not correct?

options.text: Carbon can form four single covalent bonds.
Chlorine atoms react to gain a noble gas electronic structure.
Covalent bonding involves losing and gaining electrons.
Hydrogen molecules have the formula H₂.

mx.teacher_note: Sand and water require several separation methods.

mx.name: relationship_reversal
mx.teacher_note: The original sand-and-salt mixture contained at least three components.

mx.name: surface_feature_capture
mx.teacher_note: Filtration alone completely separates sand, salt, and water.

mx.name: operation_confusion
mx.teacher_note: Evaporate the water first, then filter the dry sand-and-salt residue to collect pure salt.

intelligence.enrichment: A mixture with more than two components requires a combination of several methods of separation. Each method removes or collects components based on one property difference, so a complex mixture is separated step by step. The learner correctly applies this rule: A mixture with more than two components requires a combination of several methods of separation. One separation method should finish any mixture if it is done carefully enough.
